checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CLIENT-SENDS-REQUEST: blockHash mutual exclusivity with fromBlock/toBlock
checklist.detection_procedure: Send eth_getLogs/eth_newFilter requests with blockHash AND fromBlock/toBlock simultaneously. Verify the RPC endpoint rejects requests where blockHash coexists with range parameters. Test edge cases: empty string blockHash with valid range, valid blockHash with null range values, blockHash with fromBlock=toBlock=same block.
executable_checks: curl -X POST -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"eth_getLogs","params":[{"blockHash":"0xabc...","fromBlock":"0x1"}],"id":1}' | grep error
Verify error code and message match spec expectations for mutual exclusivity violation
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP234-Pre-condition-002. Boundary edge EDGE-CLIENT-SENDS-REQUEST from EXT-USER-JSON-RPC-FILTER to EL eth_getLogs endpoint. Covers nodes STATE-RPC-REQUEST-RECEIVED, ACTION-VALIDATE-MUTUAL-EXCLUSIVITY. Related ambiguity AMB-EIP234-02.

checklist.title: Verify internal validation logic correctly enforces blockHash/range parameter mutual exclusivity
checklist.detection_procedure: Review the parameter parsing code to confirm mutual exclusivity is checked before any block lookup occurs. Verify that the check is not bypassable via parameter ordering, null vs undefined values, or type coercion. Confirm proper error response format.
executable_checks: Static analysis of parameter validation code path
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP234-Pre-condition-002. Supporting node check for ACTION-VALIDATE-MUTUAL-EXCLUSIVITY.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RECEIVE-EOF: EOF container structural validation before metadata parsing
checklist.detection_procedure: Deploy EOF containers with malformed headers: missing magic bytes, incorrect version, truncated section headers, overlapping sections, zero-length sections. Verify all are rejected before metadata parsing begins. Test containers with valid magic but corrupted type/code/data section counts.
executable_checks: Submit EOF container with truncated header via CREATE/CREATE2
Submit EOF container with invalid section ordering
Verify rejection occurs at header validation stage, not metadata parsing
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7834-Pre-condition-002. Boundary edge from EXT-CONTRACT-DEPLOYER. EOF structural validation must reject invalid containers before metadata parsing to prevent parser confusion attacks.

checklist.title: Verify EOF header parser handles all malformed inputs without memory safety issues
checklist.detection_procedure: Fuzz the header parsing routine with containers of varying lengths (0 bytes through maximum). Check for panics, out-of-bounds reads, or incorrect section boundary calculations.
executable_checks: Fuzz test ACTION-PARSE-HEADER with malformed EOF bytecode
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7834-Pre-condition-002. Supporting node check for header parsing logic.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-SUBMIT-QUERY: resource limits on bloom filter log searches
checklist.detection_procedure: Submit eth_getLogs queries spanning very large block ranges (e.g., 0 to latest). Verify the node enforces a maximum block range or result limit. Test with wildcard topics that maximize false positive rate. Measure response time and memory usage for pathological queries.
executable_checks: eth_getLogs with fromBlock=0x0 toBlock=latest, empty address/topics filter
Verify timeout or block range limit error is returned
Monitor node memory during query execution
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLOOM-Pre-condition-003. Boundary edge from EXT-USER-JSON-RPC-BLOOM-SEARCH. Unbounded log scanning is a known DoS vector.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK: beacon block gossip validation (proposer, BLS, slot timing)
checklist.detection_procedure: Send beacon blocks via gossipsub with: (1) invalid proposer index, (2) invalid BLS signature, (3) slot from the future beyond tolerance, (4) slot from the distant past. Verify each is rejected at the gossip validation stage before entering fork choice.
executable_checks: Craft beacon block with wrong proposer index for the slot
Craft beacon block with corrupted BLS signature
Verify REJECT/IGNORE responses per gossipsub scoring
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GLOAS-P2P-Pre-condition-001. Boundary from EXT-P2P-PEER-CL to CL gossipsub. Execution payload validations replaced with bid-based checks in Gloas fork.

checklist.title: Verify beacon block gossip validation performs all required checks in correct order
checklist.detection_procedure: Review validation code to confirm: proposer index checked against beacon state, BLS signature verified with correct domain, slot timing checked against node clock with tolerance. Verify no early returns skip later checks.
executable_checks: Code review of gossip validation handler
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GLOAS-P2P-Pre-condition-001. Supporting node for internal validation logic.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-SENDS-ENVELOPE: execution payload envelope builder signature and bid matching
checklist.detection_procedure: Send execution payload envelopes with: (1) invalid builder BLS signature, (2) block root not matching any known block, (3) payload hash not matching the committed bid. Verify all are rejected. Test with valid signature but mismatched block root.
executable_checks: Craft envelope with corrupted builder signature
Craft envelope referencing non-existent block root
Verify KZG commitment validation relocated to bid message
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GLOAS-P2P-Pre-condition-005. Boundary from EXT-BUILDER-BID to CL gossipsub execution_payload topic.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-RESPONDS: sync response structural validation before database integration
checklist.detection_procedure: During sync, inject malformed blocks/envelopes in BeaconBlocksByRange responses: invalid signatures, missing fields, inconsistent slot ordering. Verify the node validates each item before integrating into the local database. Test partial valid/invalid batches.
executable_checks: Serve malformed block in BeaconBlocksByRange response
Verify invalid items are rejected without corrupting local state
Check that valid items in same batch are still processed correctly
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GLOAS-P2P-Pre-condition-009. Boundary from EXT-BEACON-PEER-SNAPSHOT to CL sync handler.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RPC-CLIENT-REQUEST: block number and uncle index parameter validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Send eth_getUncleByBlockNumberAndIndex with: negative indices, indices exceeding max uncle count (2), non-hex block numbers, block tags (latest/pending) combined with out-of-range uncle index. Verify proper error responses.
executable_checks: curl eth_getUncleByBlockNumberAndIndex with uncle index > 1
Verify error response for invalid parameter types
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3046-Pre-condition-001. Boundary from EXT-USER-JSON-RPC-UNCLE to EL.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-DAPP-REQUEST-SWITCH: wallet_switchEthereumChain target chain validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Call wallet_switchEthereumChain with: unknown chain IDs, malformed hex chain IDs, chain IDs for testnets the wallet doesn't support. Verify the wallet checks chain registry existence and serviceability before prompting user. Verify error codes match EIP-3326 spec.
executable_checks: wallet_switchEthereumChain with non-existent chainId
Verify error 4902 (chain not added) is returned
Verify user is shown requester identity and target chain info
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3326-Pre-condition-002. Boundary from EXT-DAPP-WALLET-SWITCH. Must mitigate fingerprinting via chain probing.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CALLDATA-TO-POP: CALLDATALOAD zero-pads out-of-bounds reads from untrusted calldata
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute CALLDATALOAD with offsets beyond calldata length. Verify returned value is zero-padded (not garbage/uninitialized memory). Test at exact boundary: offset = calldatasize, offset = calldatasize - 1 (partial read), offset = MAX_UINT256. Verify buffer_read implementation.
executable_checks: Deploy contract: CALLDATALOAD at offset beyond calldata, check result == 0
Test partial overlap: calldata=4 bytes, load at offset 2, verify last 30 bytes are zero
Test offset = 2^256 - 1
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-ENV-PRECOND-001. Boundary from EXT-USER-TX-SENDER. Calldata is entirely attacker-controlled. Related assumption ASSUM-CANCUN-ENV-02.

checklist.title: Verify buffer_read correctly implements zero-padding for all calldata access patterns
checklist.detection_procedure: Review buffer_read implementation for CALLDATALOAD and CALLDATACOPY. Verify zero-padding logic handles: zero-length calldata, offset overflow, size overflow, offset+size overflow. Check that memory expansion gas is charged before copy.
executable_checks: Unit test buffer_read with boundary offsets
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-ENV-PRECOND-001. Supporting node for buffer_read correctness.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for BLAKE2b precompile: input must be exactly 213 bytes
checklist.detection_procedure: Call BLAKE2b precompile (0x09) with input lengths: 0, 1, 212, 213, 214, 1000, MAX. Verify exactly 213 bytes succeeds, all others consume all gas and return failure. Test that no partial parsing occurs for wrong-length inputs.
executable_checks: CALL to 0x09 with 212-byte input, verify failure and gas consumed
CALL to 0x09 with 214-byte input, verify failure and gas consumed
CALL to 0x09 with 213-byte valid input, verify success
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLAKE2-PRECOND-001. Related ambiguity AMB-BLAKE2-02. Primary element ACTION-CHECK-INPUT-LENGTH.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RECEIVE-BLOCK: Gray Glacier difficulty validation on P2P received blocks
checklist.detection_procedure: Craft blocks with incorrect difficulty values: (1) difficulty from pre-Gray-Glacier formula, (2) difficulty with wrong bomb delay constant, (3) difficulty=0, (4) difficulty=MAX. Send via P2P and verify rejection. Verify parent header is loaded and used correctly.
executable_checks: Serve block with pre-Gray-Glacier difficulty via devp2p
Verify block is rejected with difficulty mismatch error
Verify parent header lookup succeeds for valid ancestry
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GRAYGLA-PRECOND-002. Boundary from EXT-PEER-P2P-NETWORK to EL block reception.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-SSTORE-START: SSTORE rejects execution when gasleft <= 2300 (reentrancy guard)
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute SSTORE in a reentrant call with exactly 2300 gas remaining. Verify OOG exception is thrown. Test boundary: gasleft=2300 (must fail), gasleft=2301 (must succeed). Verify the check is strictly greater-than, not greater-than-or-equal.
executable_checks: Deploy contract that calls back with 2300 gas stipend and attempts SSTORE
Verify SSTORE at gasleft=2300 reverts
Verify SSTORE at gasleft=2301 succeeds
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP2200-PRECOND-001. Boundary from EXT-REENTERING-CALL. Related AMB-EIP2200-01, ASSUM-EIP2200-04. The > vs >= boundary is critical for reentrancy prevention.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-EXT-SUBMIT-AUTH: EIP-7702 authorization chain_id validation (match or zero wildcard)
checklist.detection_procedure: Submit EIP-7702 authorizations with: (1) correct chain_id, (2) chain_id=0 (wildcard, must be accepted), (3) wrong chain_id (must be rejected), (4) chain_id=MAX_UINT256. Verify rejection produces no side effects. Verify ECDSA signature recovery is correct.
executable_checks: Submit type-0x04 tx with authorization chain_id matching current chain
Submit with chain_id=0, verify acceptance
Submit with chain_id for different network, verify rejection
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-PRAGUE-PRECOND-001. Boundary from EXT-USER-TX-SENDER to EL Prague fork types.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-RECEIVE-PROVIDER-INFO: ProviderInfo field validation and icon URI sanitization against XSS
checklist.detection_procedure: Inject ProviderInfo with: (1) missing name/icon fields, (2) icon URI = 'javascript:alert(1)', (3) icon URI = data:image/svg+xml with embedded script, (4) name containing HTML tags. Verify required fields are validated and icon URI is sanitized before rendering.
executable_checks: Inject ProviderInfo with javascript: URI icon
Inject ProviderInfo with SVG containing <script> tag
Verify rendering engine does not execute injected scripts
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7039-PRECOND-004. Related ASSUM-EIP7039-03. Covers ACTION-VALIDATE-PROVIDER-INFO and ACTION-RENDER-WALLET-INFO.

checklist.title: Verify wallet UI rendering of provider info uses safe rendering (no innerHTML) for all fields
checklist.detection_procedure: Review rendering code for ACTION-RENDER-WALLET-INFO. Verify name is rendered as text content (not innerHTML). Verify icon is loaded via img src with Content-Security-Policy restricting inline scripts. Verify no eval or dynamic script creation.
executable_checks: Code review of wallet info rendering component
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7039-PRECOND-004. Supporting node check for safe rendering.

checklist.title: Falsify: block hash lookup returns non-deterministic results under concurrent access
checklist.detection_procedure: Perform concurrent eth_getBlockByHash calls for the same block hash while the node is syncing or processing reorgs. Compare results across calls. Attempt to trigger database inconsistency by querying during block import. Test with block hashes near chain reorganization points.
executable_checks: Parallel eth_getBlockByHash requests during active sync
Query block hash immediately after reorg, verify consistent result
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP234-Invariant-002. Invariant: block database must be complete and consistent. Related ASSUM-EIP234-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: eth_getLogs returns logs not matching specified address/topics filter
checklist.detection_procedure: Query logs with specific address and topics filters for a block known to contain matching and non-matching logs. Verify every returned log matches all filter criteria. Test with: single topic, multiple topics (AND logic), null topic positions (wildcard), multiple addresses. Check for false negatives by comparing against full block receipts.
executable_checks: eth_getLogs with specific address filter, verify no foreign address logs returned
eth_getLogs with topic filter, cross-check against eth_getBlockReceipts
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP234-Post-condition-002. Post-condition on ACTION-RETRIEVE-BLOCK-LOGS.

checklist.title: Falsify: EOF container with invalid metadata size or incorrect section ordering is accepted for deployment
checklist.detection_procedure: Attempt to deploy EOF containers with: metadata size=0, metadata size=65536, metadata section placed after data section, duplicate metadata sections. Verify all deployments fail. Check that rejection state is reached and no bytecode is stored.
executable_checks: CREATE2 with EOF container having metadata size=0
CREATE2 with EOF container having wrong section order
Verify no contract code stored at expected address
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7834-Post-condition-001. Post-condition on STATE-EOF-REJECTED.

checklist.title: Falsify: metadata compiler version/source hash accepted without independent bytecode recompilation verification
checklist.detection_procedure: Deploy an EOF container with metadata claiming a specific compiler version and source hash. Provide bytecode that does NOT match what that compiler/source would produce. Verify that any verification system flags the mismatch. Test with subtly modified bytecode (single byte difference).
executable_checks: Deploy EOF with metadata claiming solc 0.8.25 but bytecode from 0.8.24
Verify verification tool detects mismatch
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP7834-Pre-condition-007. Pre-condition on ACTION-COMPARE-BYTECODE. Related ASSUM-EIP7834-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: ommer validation accepts blocks violating count, uniqueness, age, ancestry, or canonical chain constraints
checklist.detection_procedure: Construct blocks with: 3 ommers (exceeds max 2), duplicate ommer headers, ommer with age=0 or age=7, ommer not sharing ancestor with block, ommer that is in the canonical chain. Verify each is rejected by the validation logic.
executable_checks: Construct block with 3 uncle headers, verify rejection
Construct block with uncle age=7, verify rejection
Construct block with canonical chain block as uncle, verify rejection
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BYZANTIUM-Pre-condition-003. Pre-condition on ACTION-VALIDATE-OMMERS.

checklist.title: Falsify: transaction execution proceeds with invalid nonce, insufficient balance, non-EOA sender, or insufficient intrinsic gas
checklist.detection_procedure: Submit transactions with: wrong nonce (too high/too low), balance < gas*price+value, sender = contract address (if possible), gas < intrinsic gas cost. Verify each is rejected before execution begins. Test exact boundary values.
executable_checks: Send tx with nonce = account_nonce + 2, verify rejection
Send tx with value exceeding sender balance, verify rejection
Send tx with gas = intrinsic_gas - 1, verify rejection
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BYZANTIUM-Pre-condition-004. Pre-condition on ACTION-CHECK-TX.

checklist.title: Falsify: difficulty bomb calculation uses wrong BOMB_DELAY_BLOCKS value or applies delay incorrectly
checklist.detection_procedure: Compute expected difficulty for blocks at key points: block 3,000,000 (delay should make effective block=0), block 3,000,001, block 6,000,000. Compare against implementation output. Verify BOMB_DELAY_BLOCKS constant is exactly 3,000,000. Test for integer underflow when block_number < 3,000,000.
executable_checks: Calculate difficulty at block 2,999,999 with Byzantium rules
Verify bomb component uses max(0, block_number - 3000000)
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BYZANTIUM-Post-condition-005. Post-condition on ACTION-APPLY-BOMB-DELAY.

checklist.title: Falsify: gas refund exceeds 50% of gas consumed in any transaction
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute transactions that maximize refund_counter (e.g., clearing many storage slots). Verify the actual refund never exceeds gas_used/2. Test with: refund_counter > gas_used, refund_counter = gas_used/2 + 1, odd gas_used values (test rounding). Check refund = min(refund_counter, gas_used // 2).
executable_checks: Deploy contract that sets then clears 100 storage slots
Verify refund <= gas_used / 2 in transaction receipt
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BYZANTIUM-Invariant-005. Invariant on ACTION-CALCULATE-REFUND. Related ASSUM-BYZANTIUM-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: bloom filter check produces false negatives (missing blocks that contain matching logs)
checklist.detection_procedure: For blocks with known log entries, verify the bloom filter contains all required bits for those logs' addresses and topics. Compute expected bloom bits independently and compare. Test with addresses/topics that hash to overlapping bit positions.
executable_checks: Emit known event, compute expected bloom bits, verify block bloom contains them
eth_getLogs with bloom-matching filter, verify block is not skipped
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLOOM-Post-condition-002. Post-condition: bloom match implies possible log presence.

checklist.title: Falsify: bloom filter becomes saturated (all bits set) under realistic log entry counts
checklist.detection_procedure: Compute bloom filter saturation rate: with k=3 hash functions and m=2048 bits, calculate the probability of saturation for n=100, 500, 1000, 5000 log entries. Analyze mainnet blocks with highest log counts. Verify bloom false positive rate stays below practical threshold.
executable_checks: Query bloom filter of block with maximum log entries on mainnet
Count set bits, compute saturation percentage
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLOOM-Invariant-005. Invariant on STATE-BLOOM-COMPLETE. Related ASSUM-BLOOM-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: SELFDESTRUCT fails to remove contract code and storage at end of transaction
checklist.detection_procedure: Deploy a contract, call SELFDESTRUCT, then in a subsequent transaction check: EXTCODESIZE returns 0, EXTCODECOPY returns empty, storage slots return 0. Also test within same transaction: verify contract is still callable after SELFDESTRUCT (until tx ends). Test SELFDESTRUCT during revert (should not destroy).
executable_checks: SELFDESTRUCT then EXTCODESIZE in next tx, verify 0
SELFDESTRUCT inside REVERT, verify contract survives
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP6049-Post-condition-002. Post-condition on STATE-CONTRACT-MARKED-DESTROYED.

checklist.title: Falsify: bid matching uses fuzzy comparison instead of exact equality for fee_recipient and gas_limit
checklist.detection_procedure: Submit bids with fee_recipient differing by 1 byte from proposer preference. Submit bids with gas_limit differing by 1 from preference. Verify both are rejected. Test case sensitivity of address comparison. Test with checksum vs non-checksum addresses.
executable_checks: Submit bid with fee_recipient off by 1 byte, verify rejection
Submit bid with gas_limit = preference + 1, verify rejection
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-GLOAS-P2P-Invariant-001. Invariant on ACTION-CHECK-BID-MATCHES-PREFS. Related AMB-GLOAS-P2P-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: SSTORE classification proceeds without retrieving all three values (original, current, new)
checklist.detection_procedure: Trace SSTORE execution to verify all three values are loaded: original (tx-start value), current (post-previous-SSTORE value), and new (argument). Test after multiple SSTOREs to same slot in one tx: verify original stays constant, current updates. Test first-touch vs subsequent access.
executable_checks: SSTORE twice to same slot, trace gas charges match EIP-1283 rules
Verify original value is cached from transaction start
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP1283-Pre-condition-001. Pre-condition on STATE-VALUES-LOADED.

checklist.title: Falsify: dirty slot SSTORE charges gas other than 200
checklist.detection_procedure: Create a dirty slot (original != current) by performing two SSTOREs. On the second SSTORE, measure exact gas consumed. Verify it is 200 regardless of: new value = 0, new value = original, new value = arbitrary non-zero. Test all dirty slot transitions.
executable_checks: SSTORE(slot, 1), SSTORE(slot, 2): verify second SSTORE costs 200 gas
SSTORE(slot, 1), SSTORE(slot, 0): verify second SSTORE costs 200 gas
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP1283-Post-condition-004. Post-condition on ACTION-CHARGE-DIRTY-GAS.

checklist.title: Falsify: refund cap formula deviates from max(0, min(refund_counter, gas_used / 2))
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute transactions where refund_counter > gas_used/2. Verify actual refund = gas_used/2. Execute where refund_counter < gas_used/2. Verify actual refund = refund_counter. Test edge: refund_counter = 0 (verify refund = 0). Test integer division rounding for odd gas_used.
executable_checks: Clear many storage slots, verify refund = gas_used // 2
Clear one slot, verify refund = refund_counter if less than gas_used // 2
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP1283-Invariant-001. Invariant on ACTION-APPLY-REFUND-CAP.

checklist.title: Falsify: missing uncle returns non-null response instead of null
checklist.detection_procedure: Call eth_getUncleByBlockNumberAndIndex for a block with no uncles (index=0). Verify response result is null. Call for a block with 1 uncle at index=1. Verify null. Test with various block tags (latest, earliest, pending).
executable_checks: eth_getUncleByBlockNumberAndIndex for block with 0 uncles, verify null
eth_getUncleByBlockNumberAndIndex with index=1 for block with 1 uncle, verify null
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3046-Post-condition-003. Post-condition on STATE-UNCLE-NOT-FOUND.

checklist.title: Falsify: rejected chain switch returns success or wrong error code instead of appropriate error
checklist.detection_procedure: Trigger chain switch rejection via: unknown chain (expect error 4902), user rejection (expect error 4001). Verify error codes and messages match EIP-3326 specification. Verify the error is returned to the requesting dapp, not silently dropped.
executable_checks: wallet_switchEthereumChain to unknown chain, verify error 4902
wallet_switchEthereumChain then user rejects, verify error 4001
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3326-Post-condition-003. Post-condition on STATE-SWITCH-REJECTED.

checklist.title: Falsify: chain switch rejection timing reveals whether a chain is supported by the wallet
checklist.detection_procedure: Measure response time for wallet_switchEthereumChain with: (1) supported but user-rejected chain, (2) unsupported chain. Compare timing distributions over many attempts. Verify the wallet normalizes response timing to prevent distinguishing supported vs unsupported chains.
executable_checks: Time 100 requests for known-supported chain rejection
Time 100 requests for unknown chain rejection
Statistical comparison of timing distributions
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP3326-Invariant-003. Invariant on ACTION-MITIGATE-FINGERPRINTING. Related ASSUM-EIP3326-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: RIPEMD-160 precompile at 0x03 is unavailable or fails to respond to CALL
checklist.detection_procedure: CALL address 0x03 with valid input on mainnet and each supported fork. Verify success return and correct 32-byte output. Test with STATICCALL, DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE. Verify gas cost matches expected precompile pricing.
executable_checks: CALL(0x03, input='hello'), verify 32-byte output with correct RIPEMD-160 hash
STATICCALL(0x03, input=''), verify success
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-RIPEMD160-INV-002. Invariant: precompile always available at 0x03. Related AMB-CANCUN-RIPEMD160-01, ASSUM-CANCUN-RIPEMD160-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: RETURNDATACOPY produces incorrect bytes in EVM memory
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute a sub-call that returns known data. Use RETURNDATACOPY to copy various ranges to memory. Verify memory contents match expected bytes exactly. Test: full copy, partial copy from offset, copy to non-zero dest_offset, zero-length copy, copy at return data boundary.
executable_checks: Sub-call returns 0xdeadbeef, RETURNDATACOPY(0,0,4), verify memory
RETURNDATACOPY with offset=2, size=2, verify last 2 bytes
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-ENV-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition on ACTION-COPY-RETURNDATA-TO-MEMORY.

checklist.title: Falsify: BLAKE2b precompile executes incorrect number of compression rounds
checklist.detection_procedure: Call BLAKE2b precompile with rounds=0, 1, 12 (standard), 255 (max single byte), and compare output against reference implementation. Verify gas cost scales linearly with round count. Test that rounds=0 produces valid (identity-like) output.
executable_checks: BLAKE2b with rounds=12, compare output to reference vector
BLAKE2b with rounds=0, verify output matches zero-round reference
Verify gas = 0 for rounds=0, gas = 1 for rounds=1
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLAKE2-INV-002. Invariant on ACTION-CHECK-ROUNDS-REMAINING. Related ASSUM-BLAKE2-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: BLAKE2b work vector initialization incorrectly combines state/IV or mishandles final flag inversion
checklist.detection_procedure: Provide known test vectors for BLAKE2b with final flag=true and final flag=false. Verify v[0..7]=h[0..7], v[8..11]=IV[0..3], v[12]=IV[4]^t0, v[13]=IV[5]^t1, v[14]=final?~IV[6]:IV[6], v[15]=IV[7]. Compare intermediate work vector state against reference if possible.
executable_checks: BLAKE2b with final=1, compare output to EIP-152 test vector
BLAKE2b with final=0, compare output to EIP-152 test vector
Verify v[14] bit inversion by comparing final=0 vs final=1 outputs
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-BLAKE2-INV-003. Invariant on ACTION-INIT-WORK-VECTOR. Related ASSUM-BLAKE2-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: clean slot SSTORE charges incorrect gas (not 20000 for set, not 5000 for reset)
checklist.detection_procedure: Test clean slot transitions: (1) original=0, current=0, new=1 → must charge SSTORE_SET_GAS (20000). (2) original=1, current=1, new=2 → must charge SSTORE_RESET_GAS (5000). Measure exact gas consumption for each case. Also test original=0, current=0, new=0 (noop, should charge 200).
executable_checks: SSTORE to fresh slot (0→1), verify 20000 gas charged
SSTORE to existing slot (1→2), verify 5000 gas charged
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP2200-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition on ACTION-CALCULATE-CLEAN-GAS.

checklist.title: Falsify: storage slot transitions violate the EIP-2200 four-state machine (untouched/zeroed/modified/restored)
checklist.detection_procedure: Execute all possible state transitions within a single transaction: untouched→zeroed (set to 0), untouched→modified (set to non-zero != original), zeroed→modified, modified→zeroed, modified→restored (set back to original), zeroed→restored. Verify gas charges and refunds match expected state transitions for each.
executable_checks: SSTORE(slot,0) then SSTORE(slot,original): verify restored refund
SSTORE(slot,x) then SSTORE(slot,0): verify zeroed refund
Trace all transitions in single tx, verify gas accounting
checklist.notes: Traces to PROP-W0-EIP2200-INV-002. Invariant on STATE-SLOT-UNTOUCHED (state machine root).
